description: Create or update the SIEM export configuration for an organization. Enterprise plan required. destinationUrl must be HTTPS. The credential field is stored securely and never returned by GET.

authType.description: Auth method: bearer (Authorization: Bearer), basic (Authorization: Basic), api_key (X-API-Key), none. Default: bearer.

credential.description: Auth credential. Stored securely; omit to keep the existing credential.

destinationUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the SIEM endpoint to deliver events to.

format.description: Payload format: splunk_hec (HEC wrapper), elastic_ecs (ECS envelope), qradar_cef (CEF text), json (raw JSON).

includedEventTypes.description: Event types to include (default: permit, deny, override, governance).

name: atlasent_upsert_siem_config
title: AtlaSent — Upsert SIEM Config
